title: Multi Block Feature
description: Snaps the y-value of a feature placement position to the floor or the ceiling within the provided vertical search range.

identifier.description: The identifier for this feature. The identifier must include a namespace and must match the filename.

places_block.description: Reference to the multi-block to be placed, must be the first part of a multi-block.

enforce_placement_rules.description: If true, enforce the multi-blocks mayPlace checks.

randomize_rotation.description: If true, randomizes the block's cardinal orientation.

may_replace.description: A list of blocks that may be replaced during placement. Omit this field to allow any block to be replaced, except other multi-blocks.
